headline: Healthcare Implementation and AI Delivery Lead | EHR Rollouts, Clinical Workflows, Applied AI | MBBS-Trained Physician
summary: MBBS-trained physician with four years at Greenway Health, a US healthcare software company, where I ran implementations for close to 200 client practices from discovery through go-live and adoption, as the client's main contact. I was the clinical lead on Greenway's AI-first EHR, and I build AI products hands-on: I founded Roovero, an AI content SaaS with paying pilot clients, and I grade and stress-test frontier models on clinical tasks. I translate how clinical teams really work into scope that engineers can build from, and I keep stakeholders aligned through launch.
greenway_bullets: Ran EHR implementations for close to 200 client practices, many at the same time, from discovery and workflow documentation through configuration, go-live and adoption, as the client's main clinical and solutions contact.
Ran discovery with each practice to document pain points, current workflows, business processes and goals, then designed and configured practice-specific workflows and widgets.
Clinical lead for a new AI-first EHR from Aug 2025: defined provider personas, mapped end-to-end clinical workflows and built React prototypes before engineering handoff.
Turned recurring client pain points into feature requests and worked with product teams to get them built; many shipped to clients.
Trained 200+ end users, including providers, nurse practitioners, nurses and medical assistants, on the new workflows.
Triaged defects and patient safety issues from detection through stage-gate release as a member of the Patient Safety and Functional Advisory Committees.
Presented to clients and at the Greenway Engage provider conference.
skills: managing several implementations at once, discovery, workflow and scope documentation, timelines and risk tracking, go-live and adoption, client communication
AI-first EHR clinical lead, LLM evaluation and rubrics, AI-assisted build (Claude Code, Codex), webhooks and billing integrations, React prototyping
clinical workflow design, defect triage, patient safety review, stage-gate release, emergency, ICU and inpatient care
